title: DevExp lightning standup — quickstarts & samples roundup (2026-10-12)
body:
Meeting: DevExp lightning standup — focused on quickstarts, sample apps, and SDK friction observed in recent onboarding runs.
Date: 2026-10-12 (recurring Tuesday quick sync)
Attendees: Priya (owner), Ethan, Maya, Liam, Sofia, optional: Arjun (ops) dropped by for rollout note
Duration: 25 minutes (kept short)

High-level summary:
- Quickstarts: smoke tests for the new Python + TypeScript quickstarts passed on macOS and Ubuntu containers, BUT t2 instances saw timeouts when switching to the streaming example. Suspect racy socket close in sample helper.
- Samples: "todo-magic" sample (interactive chat + function-calls) needs trimming; docs are long and have several outdated step numbers after the console UI refresh.
- SDK: telemetry shows a spike in SDK initialization errors from v0.11.2 on Node 18; likely caused by a subtle race in auto-retry + fetch polyfill.

Decisions made:
1) Hold the quickstart streaming example behind an opt-in flag (QUICKSTART_STREAMING=true) until we patch the helper. This prevents onboarding timeouts for new users. (Owner: Priya — implement flag + docs update)
2) Archive legacy "step-by-step CLI" instructions in quickstarts and replace with a condensed "fast path" + optional expanded section. (Owner: Maya — write the condensed copy and create a migration PR)
3) Hotfix SDK init behavior for Node 18 as patch priority P0. If we can't get a patch out in 48 hours we will add a note in the SDK release page and quickstart README to pin to v0.11.1. (Owner: Ethan + Liam — debug + PR)

Blockers / Open issues:
- SAMPLE-CATALOG sync: sample index generator is intermittently skipping images during the build step on CI. Cause unknown; may be a race with image fetcher. (Assigned: Sofia)
- Customer report (CS ticket #7438) where the example embedding call in the "search-starter" quickstart returns different vector dims on Windows vs Linux. Need to confirm whether serialization or seed differences. (Assigned: Priya + Engineering on-call)
- Docs localization: Spanish quickstarts missing latest CLI flags. Translation team has capacity constraints this week. We will prioritize targeted strings only. (Triage: keep minimal set)

Action items (concrete):
- Priya: add QUICKSTART_STREAMING opt-in flag, update quickstart README to mention opt-in and known issue. Due: 2026-10-14. Linked PR to be created.
- Ethan: reproduce Node 18 init error locally with the telemetry harness; prepare failing test. Due: 2026-10-13 EOD.
- Liam: once Ethan has failing test, isolate the retry logic; propose patch. Target PR: 2026-10-14.
- Maya: create condensed quickstart copy (130–200 words per quickstart) and post to the doc-review channel. Due: 2026-10-15.
- Sofia: run CI reproduction for sample-catalog image skip; capture logs and open issue in samples repo. Due: 2026-10-13.
- Arjun: hold a 30-min session with infra to understand CI run ordering; optional. Tentative: 2026-10-14.

Notes to self / working hypotheses (rough):
- Streaming timeouts: likely due to helper not setting TCP_NODELAY or not flushing after first partial chunk on Windows containers; low-confidence. Try forcing immediate flush in helper and increase socket timeout as mitigant.
- Node 18 SDK race: fetch polyfill + auto-retry hook may be intercepting the global fetch during module init in some bundlers. Could be reproducible by bundling SDK with esbuild and running in Node 18.

Quick wins we can ship this week:
- Feature flag for streaming quickstart (low-risk) — fast win, unblocks onboarding.
- Condensed quickstart front-page (reduces cognitive load for first-time users).
- Add a note on SDK release page to pin to v0.11.1 if we can't patch in 48h.

Follow-ups / longer-term items (backlog):
- Add end-to-end test matrix for quickstarts: combinations of OS (macOS, Ubuntu, Windows), Node/Python versions, and streaming vs non-streaming. Estimated 2 sprint effort.
- Samples: propose a "prune + canonicalize" pass to keep 6 curated samples for onboarding funnel; rest go to samples-archive. (MVP doc to be written by Maya)
- Localization: build a small script to extract only critical doc strings for urgent translations to reduce translation load. (Sofia to prototype)

Meeting close: next sync Tue 2026-10-19, same time. If any P0s appear, we will call an ad-hoc triage.

Raw quick bits / scratch (unpolished):
- "todo-magic" needs smaller codeblocks — users copy huge blocks and skip the function call wiring. Could add a collapsed code snippet with a copy button.
- Consider a short video (60s) that runs the "fast path" quickstart and shows console success; could live in README to reduce reading friction.
- Slack thread refs: #quickstarts (internal), #sdk-bugs.

Unresolved questions to bring up at sync:
- Do we want to default non-streaming examples for first-time users indefinitely? pros/cons
- Who owns quickstart e2e matrix maintenance once we add it to CI? Ops? DevExp?

-- end of notes (working doc)
